csv_project_name: Engineering Services for Airport Capital Improvement Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The Ware County Board of Commissioners is seeking a qualified aviation consulting firm to provide professional planning, engineering, architectural, and construction administration services in connection with the Airport Capital Improvement Plan at the Waycross-Ware County Airport in Waycross, Georgia. a. DBE Plan Update FY27-FY29 b. Runway 1-19 Electrical Design w/new PAPI s and Beacon Light c. Obstruction Clearing Construction d. Runway 1-19 Electrical Construction w/new PAPI s and Beacon Light e. Terminal Building Design (Phase I) f. Terminal Building Phase I Bid and Construction g. Taxiway A Rejuvenation and Lighting w/Conduit Design h. Terminal Building Phase 2 Design i. Terminal Building Phase 2 Bid and Construction j. Taxiway A Rejuvenation and Lighting w/Conduit Construction k. New AWOS l. Runway 5-23 Pavement Rehabilitation - Design m. Airport Layout Plan Update n. Land Acquisition o. Such other airport-related work as the Ware County Board of Commissioners may deem necessary.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Transportation Planning
csv_comments: '- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 07/27/2026 02:00 PM EDT
title: Engineering Services for Airport Capital Improvement Plan
short_description: Engineering and architectural services for airport upgrades, rehabilitation, and terminal building phases.
project_location: Waycross-Ware County Airport, Waycross, Georgia, USA
project_scope: Multi-year airport capital improvement program including DBE plan update FY27-FY29; Runway 1-19 electrical design and construction with new PAPIs and beacon light; obstruction clearing construction; Terminal Building Phase I design, bid, and construction administration; Taxiway A rejuvenation and lighting with conduit design and construction; Terminal Building Phase 2 design, bid, and construction administration; new AWOS; Runway 5-23 pavement rehabilitation design; airport layout plan update; and land acquisition.
services: Professional aviation consulting services including planning, engineering, architectural design, rehabilitation/refurbishment, civil engineering, construction administration/project management, land use planning, master planning, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an airport planning and multidisciplinary aviation consulting assignment.
- Includes terminal building design, which could involve building structures, but no size, span, or structural complexity is stated.
- Major listed tasks focus on airfield electrical works, pavement rehabilitation, planning updates, and land acquisition, which are only marginally relevant to sbp.
- No clear emphasis on special structures, long spans, bridges, stadiums, or innovative lightweight structural design.
- Construction/project management components are present, but not as a distinct structural engineering opportunity.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender notice. Relevant scope items for a rough estimate include terminal building Phase I and Phase 2, runway electrical works with PAPIs and beacon, taxiway rejuvenation and lighting, AWOS, obstruction clearing, and runway pavement rehabilitation, but the notice provides no quantities, areas, lengths, or phasing budgets.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the tender notice. The procurement is for on-call/professional services across multiple airport improvement tasks over a 60-month contract duration, but there is no explicit design fee, percentage, or estimated contract value.
references_qualifications: Qualified aviation consulting firm; disciplines requested include architecture services, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, construction/project management, land use planning, planning/master planning, and transportation planning.
contracting_authority: Ware County Board of Commissioners, Waycross, Georgia, USA. Contact: Mr. James Shubert. Phone: 912-287-4300. Fax: 912-287-4450. Email: jshubert@warecountyga.gov. notes: Project #868600; Agency ID 11379; Project ID 1014051; DR #202600258283. Contract duration: 60. Renewable: No. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Questions deadline: 2026-07-27 02:00 PM EDT. Although the assignment includes terminal building design, the notice is dominated by airport-wide planning and infrastructure tasks rather than a clearly defined structural building project.
